description.en: The ID of the user to be removed. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetUser](~~147098~~) operation to obtain the user ID.

description.zh:
对象ID：

- 项目空间ID（Id），可通过调用接口[GetLhSpaceByName](~~424379~~)获取该参数的值。
- 任务流ID（Id），可通过调用接口[ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The ID of the object.

*   If the object is a workspace, you can call the [GetLhSpaceByName](~~424379~~) operation to obtain the workspace ID.
*   If the object is a task flow, you can call the [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain the task flow ID.

description.zh:
对象类型，取值如下：
- **0**：项目空间
- **1**：任务流
description.en:
The type of the object. Valid values:

*   **0**: workspace
*   **1**: task flow

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

title.zh: 删除项目空间成员或任务流开发者
title.en: Delete a project space member or a task stream developer

descriptions.zh:
前提条件：您的用户角色为管理员、DBA或项目管理员。  
补充说明：本接口不支持移交任务流负责人，移交项目空间任务流负责人请调用[ChangLhDagOwner](~~424761~~)接口。
descriptions.en:
Prerequisites: Your user role must be administrator, DBA, or project administrator.  
Additional note: This API does not support transferring ownership of a task stream. To transfer ownership of a task stream in a project space, invoke the [ChangLhDagOwner](~~424761~~) API.
